classes.CChartSink:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents Ch As Chart
Public Log As String
Private Sub Ch_Activate()
    Log = Log & "chart act:" & Ch.Name & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Ch_Deactivate()
    Log = Log & "chart deact:" & Ch.Name & ";"
End Sub
classes.CSheetSink:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents Ws As Worksheet
Public Log As String
Private Sub Ws_Activate()
    Log = Log & "sheet act;"
End Sub
Private Sub Ws_Deactivate()
    Log = Log & "sheet deact;"
End Sub
classes.CBookSink:
Option Explicit
Public WithEvents Wb As Workbook
Public Log As String
Private Sub Wb_SheetActivate(ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "book sheetact:" & TypeName(Sh) & ":" & Sh.Name & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Wb_SheetDeactivate(ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "book sheetdeact:" & TypeName(Sh) & ":" & Sh.Name & ";"
End Sub
Private Sub Wb_NewSheet(ByVal Sh As Object)
    Log = Log & "book new:" & TypeName(Sh) & ";"
End Sub

probes.name: pages_sheet
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Chart
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
ws.Name = "One"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
Set ch = wb.Charts.Add
ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
Probe = TypeName(ch.PrintedCommentPages) & " " & ch.PrintedCommentPages
wb.Close False
End Function

probes.name: pages_embedded
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Chart
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
ws.Name = "One"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
Set ch = wb.Charts.Add
ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
Dim e As Object
Set e = ws.ChartObjects.Add(48, 96, 240, 144).Chart
On Error Resume Next
Dim v As Variant
v = e.PrintedCommentPages
Probe = Err.Number & " " & TypeName(v) & " " & v
On Error GoTo 0
wb.Close False
End Function

probes.name: save_as_sheet
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Chart
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
ws.Name = "One"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
Set ch = wb.Charts.Add
ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
Dim path As String
path = Environ("TEMP") & "\pyov_chart_sheet_save_as.xlsx"
If Dir(path) <> "" Then Kill path
ch.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
Probe = wb.Name & "|" & (Dir(path) <> "") & "|" & wb.Sheets.Count & "|" & ActiveSheet.Name
wb.Close False
Kill path
End Function

probes.name: events_chart_to_sheet
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Chart
Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
ws.Name = "One"
ws.Range("A1:C1").Value = Array("", "Rev", "Cost")
ws.Range("A2:C2").Value = Array("a", 10, 4)
ws.Range("A3:C3").Value = Array("b", 20, 6)
Set ch = wb.Charts.Add
ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C3")
Dim c As New CChartSink, s As New CSheetSink, b As New CBookSink
Set c.Ch = ch
Set s.Ws = ws
Set b.Wb = wb
Application.EnableEvents = True
ws.Activate
Probe = "[" & c.Log & "][" & s.Log & "][" & b.Log & "]"
Application.EnableEvents = False
wb.Close False
End Function
